item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a science class, Meera opens the window and tells her friend Arjun that the air in their classroom is a mixture, not a pure substance.

Which statement best explains why air is a mixture?

options.A: Air is a mixture because it is invisible and looks the same everywhere in the room.
options.B: Air is a mixture because it contains several gases such as nitrogen, oxygen, argon and carbon dioxide that are physically mixed but not chemically combined into one substance.
options.C: Air is a mixture because two or more gases present together must react chemically and form a compound.
options.D: Air is not a mixture because the gases in it cannot be separated from one another.
